none: PAS NLM-7A6E36: Roman Radiate of Victorinus from Kirmington
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP C VICTORINVS PF AVG ; R/ PIETAS AVG

Copper alloy. Coin. Radiate of Victorinus (269-271), Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: IMP C VICTORINVS PF AVG. Reverse description: Pietas standing left sacrificing over altar and holding box of incense. Reverse inscription: PIETAS AVG. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin, citing Sear volume 3 page 384 no. 11176. Diameter: 21.4mm, Weight: 2.30gms, die axis: 6
